assets.source: Technique sequence adapted from American College of Surgeons STOP THE BLEED training resources, 2026-09-29
assets.alt: Four panels show calling emergency services, pressing directly on a wound, packing an appropriate wound if trained, and tightening a commercial tourniquet on a severely bleeding limb.
assets.caption: Call, press, pack if trained, and use a commercial tourniquet for severe limb bleeding.
